parameters.note: The tilt the capture screen still calls level (K-601). H1 2.4: a level/tilt indicator is one of the three cheap aids that standardise the pose (Wong 2021: pose standardisation halves the precision error); the research gives no tolerance. Two degrees: within what a hand on a phone stand holds, small enough that the frame does not visibly lean. Product choice, no source for the number.

How strongly the last photo of the same pose shows over the viewfinder (H1 2.4: onion-skin overlay of the previous photo). Faint enough to see the live picture through it, strong enough to line up with. Product choice.
The self-timer (prototype 4.1 '10 s timer'): H1 2.4 asks for a fixed distance with the camera at chest height, so the phone stands and the user steps back into the frame. Product choice.
The camera's JPEG compression for a progress photo (expo-camera takePictureAsync quality, 0-1). Kept on the phone only and compared by eye; high enough that the outline is sharp. Product choice.
